howtos.title: Install a Claude artifact as a desktop app
howtos.what: Turn an artifact Claude builds into an app on Mac or Windows that can use your connectors.
copy: Ask Claude to build an artifact.
Open it like any other app. It can use your connectors and, if you allow it, send notifications or add a menu bar item.
howtos.whenToUse: When a small tool you built in Claude should live on your desktop instead of in a chat.
